trainer.dialogueBefore: Jogger Richard: A morning run and a morning battle. Best way to start the day!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Jogger Richard: Phew! I'm more out of breath from that than from the run.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Jogger Raul: Up with the sun and ready to go! Keep pace with me if you can!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Jogger Raul: You win. I'll run it off.

jogger_richard_no_battle.name: Jogger
dialog: Huff... huff... Can't stop now, I'm keeping my pace!
Catch me first thing in the morning. That's when I've got the breath to battle.

jogger_raul_no_battle.name: Jogger
dialog: My run's nearly done for the day. My legs have nothing left for a battle.
Mornings! I'm full of beans in the mornings.

pokefan_m.name: Man
dialog: That tower up ahead is the Lost Tower.
People climb it to remember Pokémon who are no longer with them. Go quietly, if you go in.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Breeder Albert: I've raised these little ones since the day they hatched. Let's see how they've grown!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Breeder Albert: They're still young. Every battle teaches them something, win or lose.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Breeder Jennifer: Don't be fooled by their size. My babies are tougher than they look!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Breeder Jennifer: Back home for a nap, all of you. You've more than earned it.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Cowgirl Shelley: Easy now... My Ponyta's been itching for a gallop all day. Let's go!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Cowgirl Shelley: Whoa there! Looks like we bit off more than we could chew.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Poké Kid Danielle: My Pichu is my very best friend! Will you battle us?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Poké Kid Danielle: Are you all right, Pichu? We'll be stronger next time, I promise!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Emma: Lil and I do everything together. Battles too!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Emma: Well, at least we lost together, Lil.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Lil: Two of us and two of our Pokémon. That's fair, isn't it?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Lil: Emma, I think we need a bit more practice.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Sue: We're out for a walk together, and you want a battle? Oh, go on then!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Sue: Never mind, Ty. It was still a lovely afternoon.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ty: Sue and I make a brilliant team. Watch this!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ty: And I so wanted to look good in front of Sue...

signs.trainer_tips_signpost:
Trainer Tips
The Bag keeps what you carry in pockets. Key Items, such as a Bicycle or a fishing rod, have a pocket all their own.
